free_tier.stated: Start free, no card required, then pay for usage; the Developer plan is $20/month including $20 of usage with up to 100 concurrent sandboxes, 4 vCPU and 16 GiB per sandbox and unlimited runtime; the Pro plan is $250/month including $250 of usage with up to 2,000 concurrent sandboxes

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

egress.terms: estimates exclude network charges; the pricing page lists compute, memory and retained-storage rates only and states no transfer allowance and no per-GB price

interface_detail: REST API, the `@superserve/cli` CLI and a TypeScript SDK; no SSH found in the docs read

limits.value: up to 100 concurrent sandboxes on Developer, up to 2,000 on Pro, with unlimited runtime on both

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.

identity_cost.detail: sign up for free in the Superserve Console, no card required, and create an API key; unverified: the exact fields on the signup form were not read, so the identity kind is not established beyond an email/account gate

reliability_note: sandboxes pause with changes saved and compute stops billing while paused; no idle reap or other reliability event stated
confidence_note: the pricing page was read on 2026-10-22. The page states 'No time limit on sandboxes', which is the wall-clock axis, and 20 concurrent sandboxes is the bound
